news.title: Ajay Mitchell, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander lead injury-riddled Thunder past Suns 125-114
news.text: — Ajay Mitchell scored a career-high 30 points, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander added 26 and the short-handed Oklahoma City Thunder beat the Phoenix Suns 125-114 on Monday night.

news.title: Suddenly thin Thunder lose Alex Caruso to ankle sprain
news.text: The already-thin Oklahoma City Thunder lost guard Alex Caruso to a right ankle sprain in Monday night's game vs. the Suns.

news.title: Jalen Williams, Cason Wallace injured: What's next for the OKC Thunder?
news.text: The Thunder will be without two starting guards for months. Could they make a trade to try to replace Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace?

news.title: OKC's Jalen Williams (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder) to undergo surgery
news.text: Thunder guards Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace will both be sidelined indefinitely after undergoing ankle and shoulder surgery, respectively.

news.title: NBA breakout players: 30 ready for the next step (yes, even Wemby and Luka)
news.text: Steady starter to an All-Star lock? Top-10 talent to an MVP? Breakout seasons take many forms in the NBA. Ben Golliver identifies 30 players primed to take the next step.

news.title: Phoenix visits Oklahoma City after Booker's 43-point game
news.text: Phoenix Suns (1-1, eighth in the Western Conference) vs. Oklahoma City Thunder (3-0, third in the Western Conference)

news.title: Thunder stay undefeated with a 108-101 victory over the Clippers
news.text: — Shai-Gilgeous Alexander scored 34 points, Ajay Mitchell had 18 off the bench and the Oklahoma City Thunder stayed undefeated with a 108-101 victory over the Los Angeles Clippers on Sunday night.

news.title: Thunder star Jalen Williams taken off court on stretcher with significant injury
news.text: There was no immediate diagnosis from the Thunder on Jalen Williams' injury, with coach Mark Daigneault saying the team would be briefed Monday morning.

news.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's record 20-point streak ends in Thunder win over Nuggets
news.text: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's historic streak of 20-point games ended Thursday night when he finished with 17 in a 96-84 win over the Nuggets.

news.title: Thunder overcome SGA's shooting woes to beat Nuggets 96-84 in home opener
news.text: — Jalen Williams scored 21 points, Chet Holmgren had 12 points and 17 rebounds, and the Oklahoma City Thunder withstood a poor shooting night from Shai-Gilgeous-Alexander in their home opener to beat the Denver Nuggets 96-84 on Thursday.

news.title: How Sam Presti's 'slow and steady' trust in SGA created a two-time MVP
news.text: The Thunder GM and the two-time MVP have created a partnership that fueled OKC's rise.

news.title: Takeaways: LeBron at center?! Why the 76ers had to get creative on opening night
news.text: Brian Windhorst examines a surprising shift for LeBron, plus more takeaways from the NBA's season-opening tripleheader.

news.title: Spurs' Victor Wembanyama misses first 12 shots in rough opener vs. Thunder
news.text: Victor Wembanyama didn't record his first bucket until the end of the third quarter and shot a career-worst 8% from the field as the Thunder got their revenge on the Spurs in Tuesday's Western Conference finals rematch.

news.title: Thunder win chippy opener vs. Spurs, throw support behind Chet Holmgren
news.text: The scrap early in the second quarter of Tuesday night's season opener offered some symbolism for Chet Holmgren and his Thunder teammates. Holmgren landed with a thud. As he got back to his feet, his teammates had his back.
